sportradar.note: documented-shape mapping for payloads handed in by an authorized operator; never connects, never reads credentials

sportsdataio.note: documented-shape mapping for payloads handed in by an authorized operator; never connects, never reads credentials

capture_design.rule: once a provider is authorized (acceptance classification ACCEPTED_*), a capture job calls ingest_qb_state inside each cutoff window with no architecture change; revisions become new rows

forecast_gate.abstention: ABSTAIN_QB_STATE_UNCERTIFIED is logged and counted per team-game and cutoff

functions.certify_for_forecast: certify_for_forecast(team, game_id, cutoff, label) -> CERTIFIED | UNCERTAIN | BLOCKED used by the forward engine; only CERTIFIED may produce an official QB projection
functions.evaluate_provider: acceptance harness: historical 2024 record, original timestamp, revisions, expected starter, health status, T24 and T90 reconstruction, player identity join, live game -> ACCEPTED_FOR_PHASE1L | ACCEPTED_FORWARD_ONLY | REJECTED
functions.ingest_qb_state: ingest_qb_state(provider_payload, retrieved_at, provider, crosswalk=None) -> appends the raw payload and the normalized Phase1M rows; refuses unauthorized providers
functions.state_at: state_at(team, game, cutoff_time, label=None, certified_only=True) -> visible rows and the conservative starter reading (Phase1M visibility rule; later revisions never leak backward)

phase1l: unchanged: BLOCKED_STARTER_STATE_DATA until real payloads pass the harness

storage.raw_layer: phase2a_qb_state/raw_payloads.jsonl (provider, retrieved_at, payload_sha256, payload) hash-chained append-only
